name: zzzparanoidal-start-bnl
title: PARANOIDAL: Start with BnL
author: FactorioParanoidal; machines and graphics: darkfrei, sbelyakov (Looting Spaceship Wrecks); AAI wreck graphics: Earendel; scrap graphics: Wube Software (Factorio: Space Age)
description: The whole start of Paranoidal (formerly PARANOIDAL: start shipwreck): the crashed BnL ship, its debris and the AAI wrecks with their supplies and quality, the salvaged machines, plus the new start: debris still falling from the sky, burning wrecks whose ammo cooks off and spoils the cargo, a debris trail west-south-west with detached compartments (a dying reactor, medbay, armory, hydroponics, engineering bay), the flight recorder, BnL insurance supply pods, professions, landing anomalies, a scrap deposit, the previous expedition, the ship turret, the captain's safe, multiplayer escape pods, the distress signal and the intro flight.
